name: Sanagawa Hijiri
source:
The student council president at the protagonist's academy. An exemplary student with top grades and athletic prowess.

Though beautiful, she has an inscrutable side that makes her seem unapproachable. However, she actually adores cute things, and instantly turns into a complete klutz when faced with them.

She tries to hide her cute hobby, but it's obvious to the members of “Larimar Bell”. She believes there's something lacking within herself and seems to be studying to address it.

To overcome her tendency to become useless around cute things, she undergoes special training with the protagonist. However, during this process, she awakens a ‘masochistic tendency’ completely opposite her usual resolute self.

Perhaps as a reaction to her strict upbringing, she becomes intensely curious about previously unfamiliar erotic matters. She adores being commanded by the protagonist and experiencing embarrassing situations, even going so far as to suggest new play styles herself.

“There's no way I could ever let anyone see me getting all flustered over cute things. You never know where my students might be lurking... I have to be careful.”

[From [url=https://app.candysoft.jp/products/shibasoft/lovecoordination#chara]official site[/url]]
